_comment: Template for the hosted version.json the Inventorizer update engine polls. Host this file anywhere (GitHub raw URL works), then set UpdateUrl in the $Brand block of Inventorizer.ps1 to its URL. 'version' is the latest available build; 'scriptUrl' is the raw download of that build's Inventorizer.ps1; 'sha256' (optional but recommended) is the hash of that file - get it with: Get-FileHash .\Inventorizer.ps1 -Algorithm SHA256. 'highlights' are the big-ticket items shown on the update offer screen; 'notes' are the in-depth small fixes shown in the full changelog. List newest entries first; the updater shows every entry newer than the running version.

highlights: NEW :: example major feature the user is missing out on
REWORKED :: example of a majorly reworked system
notes: fixed the bug with the video driver listing function incorrectly displaying AMD driver versions
adjusted the density bar timing on slow terminals
patch releases usually only carry notes - they still appear in the full changelog view
